{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Maximum''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
It was commanded by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] while he was searching for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operatives and [[Habassan Envoy]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the game [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']], the ''Maximum'' arrives on Tour of Duty 5 Mission 12 if [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron's]] B-Wings have been disabled. It also turns up on Mission 20A of Tour of Duty 5 if [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Cathleen]]'' gets destroyed.
